children: Avalanche founder Emin Gün Sirer said AI could uncover software flaws in the XRP Ledger before it breaks cryptography, arguing the threat deserves more attention than the fall of existing cryptography. According to BeInCrypto, he said attackers could exploit system-level bugs in blockchain code, libraries and wallets to steal billions, while noting he did not identify any unpatched XRP Ledger vulnerability or demonstrate an attack. The warning comes after the ledger’s emergency software update on September 25 and renewed scrutiny over its security fixes.

title: Avalanche Founder Warns AI Could Expose XRP Ledger Flaws
